section_summary.extract_value: This section describes two measurement instruments used in the present study: the Sociocultural Attitudes Towards Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3), a 30-item scale measuring media influences on body image across four factors, and the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item unidimensional scale measuring positive body image. Both instruments use 5-point Likert-type scales and demonstrated good internal reliability in the study (SATAQ-3 subscales: α = .83–.93; BAS: α = .90).
